Downtown Miami.name: Downtown Miami
Downtown Miami.description: County civic and office core around Government Center with tower conversions and the densest issued-permit pipeline.

Brickell.name: Brickell
Brickell.description: Financial-district high-rise spine south of the Miami River with luxury condo and office-to-residential conversions.

Wynwood / Edgewater.name: Wynwood / Edgewater
Wynwood / Edgewater.description: Warehouse-district adaptive reuse and bayfront mid-rise infill north of downtown.

South Beach.name: South Beach
South Beach.description: Art Deco hotel-renovation corridor on Ocean Drive with the island's highest hospitality-license density.

Mid-Beach.name: Mid-Beach
Mid-Beach.description: Collins Avenue hotel and condo spine north of South Beach with renovation-led permitting.

Key Biscayne.name: Key Biscayne
Key Biscayne.description: Barrier-island village with estate renovations and strict coastal-construction overlays.

Coral Gables.name: Coral Gables
Coral Gables.description: Mediterranean-revival planned city with Miracle Mile retail and high-value residential renovations.

Coconut Grove.name: Coconut Grove
Coconut Grove.description: Bayfront village of cottages and marinas with teardown pressure on large lots.

South Miami / Pinecrest.name: South Miami / Pinecrest
South Miami / Pinecrest.description: US-1 corridor suburbs with estate lots, independent retail, and renovation-led licensing.

Hialeah.name: Hialeah
Hialeah.description: Industrial and small-lot residential grid with dense local-business-tax and contractor licensing.

Miami Gardens.name: Miami Gardens
Miami Gardens.description: North-county suburban grid at the Broward line with single-family infill and neighborhood services.

Aventura.name: Aventura
Aventura.description: Northeast-county condo and mall node at the Broward line — county identity, not Fort Lauderdale.

Doral.name: Doral
Doral.description: West-county office-park and warehouse city with the metro's densest new-construction industrial pipeline.

Sweetwater.name: Sweetwater
Sweetwater.description: FIU-adjacent west corridor with small-lot residential and service-license density.

Westchester.name: Westchester
Westchester.description: Bird Road suburban grid between the airport and Coral Gables with renovation-led permitting.

Kendall.name: Kendall
Kendall.description: South-Dade suburban commercial spine along Kendall Drive with medical and retail licensing.

Cutler Bay.name: Cutler Bay
Cutler Bay.description: South-county lakeside suburbs with small-lot infill and neighborhood services.

Homestead / Florida City.name: Homestead / Florida City
Homestead / Florida City.description: Agricultural south-county edge with new-construction tract housing and the county's southern permit cluster.
